define.name: UAVCAN_ACTUATORS_USE_CURRENT
define.description: Enable the usage of the current sensing in the ESC telemetry

define.name: UAVCAN_ACTUATORS_TELEM_IDX
define.description: Only report these ESC indices in the ESC telemetry message (counted over UAVCAN1 then UAVCAN2), to get a higher update rate for them. Default: all ESCs

define.name: ACTUATOR_UAVCAN1_CMD_TYPES
define.description: Command types: UNITLESS, POSITION, FORCE, SPEED or PWM. Default: UNITLESS

define.name: ACTUATOR_UAVCAN1_CMD_FACTORS
define.description: Nonzero divisors for actuator command values. Default: 9600

define.name: ACTUATOR_UAVCAN2_CMD_TYPES
define.description: Command types: UNITLESS, POSITION, FORCE, SPEED or PWM. Default: UNITLESS

define.name: ACTUATOR_UAVCAN2_CMD_FACTORS
define.description: Nonzero divisors for actuator command values. Default: 9600
